body.description: Background ambient air concentration at a coordinate for PM2.5 (annual and 24-hour) and NO2 (annual and 1-hour), as the EPA design value from the nearest representative regulatory monitor, with the monitor's AQS site id and distance. This is the measured concentration already in the air before my project adds anything.
body.use_case: A PSD or minor NSR permit needs a NAAQS compliance demonstration: modeled impact from the new source PLUS existing background must stay under the standard. Today I have to hand-pull design values from EPA AQS per site, which is the slowest manual step in the whole screen. Background is what decides whether a 500 MW gas plant's modeled increment fits under the 1-hour NO2 NAAQS or not.
body.decision_threshold: Annual PM2.5 NAAQS is 9.0 ug/m3 and 1-hour NO2 is 100 ppb. If background already consumes most of the standard the project needs tighter controls, a taller stack, or a different parcel. The decision flips somewhere around 70 percent of the standard consumed.

expected_volume.geography: every US county centroid plus ~3000 tracked project sites

suggested.name: EPA AQS design values
suggested.why: the values regulators actually accept in a permit application

suggested.name: EPA AQS monitor network
suggested.why: monitor locations for the nearest-representative-monitor join

output_preference.units: ug/m3 for PM2.5, ppb for NO2

example_locations.note: Loudoun County VA — ozone nonattainment (2015 8-hr, Moderate), the densest data center market in the world
